text:
ellie: Quick sync — we have 6 potential design partners for Private+HSM beta. Need to pick 3 and finalize ask. Shortlist: 1) FinCore (PCI+kms), 2) HealthSync (PHI + airgap), 3) NeonDocs (PII-heavy), 4) RetailEdge (edge VPC), 5) EduLab (low-latency inference), 6) GovCloudCo (compliance reqs). Thoughts?

sanjay: Thanks. I think criteria = data sensitivity, deployment complexity, ability to run sample workload for 2 weeks, and willingness to share latency/cost metrics. Prioritize PCI/PHI first.

devon: Agree. Also check if customers can commit to our tracing hooks and token-level cost logs. We need their consent for KV cache snapshots for debugging :eyes:

lina: Suggest picking 1 high-risk (HealthSync), 1 high-volume (RetailEdge or EduLab), and 1 compliance-heavy (FinCore or GovCloudCo). Success metrics: <10% regression vs baseline for quality, average p95 latency <= 250ms, and ability to reproduce an investigator ticket within 48h.

ellie: Solid. Can each of you own reachout for one or two partners? I'll draft the ask. Target start date = 2025-07-07 (2-week runway for infra prep).

devon: I'll ping RetailEdge and EduLab. Will confirm infra windows.

sanjay: I'll take HealthSync + GovCloudCo. Will loop legal on PHI/SOC2 scoping.

lina: I'll message FinCore and NeonDocs. I'll include a short technical checklist.

ops-bot: Created issue RINF-8421: "Private+HSM DP intake & triage" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-8421. Added ellie,sanjay,devon,lina. 

ellie: Thanks — can we agree on a 2-question quick screener email: 1) Can you run a 2-week test in a VPC with our agent? 2) Can you share sample payloads + SLOs? I'll paste draft in #docs after lunch.

sanjay: +1. Keep it tight. Offer 3 sessions of onboarding support and 1 dev hour/week as incentive.

devon: Also include a prompt set for evaluation and a minimal perf harness (curl example) in the invite. Small snippet:

`````
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/private/infer \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"prompt":"<sample>"}'
`````

lina: I'll add the quality eval bundle and baseline prompts. ellie — if you want, I can draft the invite copy.

ellie: Please do. I'll assemble tracker columns: contacted, committed, infra-ready, onboarding-complete, evaluation-pass. Let's reconvene EOD Friday for final list. :calendar: 

devon: EOD Friday works.

sanjay: 👍

lina: 👍

ellie: Thanks team — feeling good about this approach. :rocket:
